newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash crudes end sharply higher, diffs lacking.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash crudes end sharply higher, diffs lacking.

text.p: Prices for cash crudes in the U.S. ended squarely above the $26.00 barrel mark Monday, tracking weather-related rallying on the NYMEX futures market.

Many cash players scratched their heads at the extreme price spikes, thinking outright crudes were well-placed for a retreat. But, heating oil futures led the crudes to a nearly 90 cents advance on the widespread forecasts calling for colder-than-normal temperatures in the eastern portions of the U.S., potentially stoking heating oil demand.
February West Texas Intermediate/Cushing closed out around 80 cts higher, after a slight retreat after the NYMEX settle.
